subject: Supplier activation paperwork & conditional PO for Avery Systems
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Supplier activation paperwork & conditional PO for Avery Systems

Hi Liam / Avery onboarding team,

Welcome — excited to get Avery Systems set up as an approved supplier for Redwood. To complete procurement activation and issue a PO we need the following items by EOD Friday (PST):

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing:
  • General Liability $1M each occurrence / $2M aggregate
  • Additional insured endorsement naming “Redwood Inference, Inc.”
  • Waiver of subrogation (if available)
- Fully executed W-9 (for US vendors)
- Completed vendor profile (I attached our template) with bank remit details
- Short safety/compliance questionnaire (three questions below)

Bullet answers for the questionnaire are fine:
1) Do you host any production customer data in your systems? (yes/no)
2) Do you use subcontractors to fulfill services? If yes, do they carry equivalent insurance?
3) Is there an incident response contact for security or production outages?

We can issue a conditional PO (PO-987412) to begin procurement workflows while insurance is under review; final payment will be contingent on acceptance of the COI/endorsements. If there are timing constraints let me know — we can coordinate a short dev/test payment window if needed.

I attached our COI requirements PDF and the vendor profile template to speed things up. Also copying Vivek for any legal/terms questions and Kim for invoice routing.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: supplier_coi_requirements.pdf (pdf), vendor_profile_template.docx (docx)
